item.name: Get eligible delivery windows for order

request.name: Get eligible delivery windows for order

description.content: Find delivery windows available for a specific order based on the order's store location and requirements. Requires either order_id or external_order_id. Optionally filter by time range and requested capacity.

query.description: The order for which to return eligible delivery windows.
The external order id for which to return eligible delivery windows.
(Required) The range start for delivery windows.
(Required) The range end for delivery windows.
Optionally specify the requested capacity for the delivery windows.

item.name: Book a delivery window for order

request.name: Book a delivery window for order

description.content: Reserve a delivery window for an order identified by external ID. The booking holds capacity in the window until confirmed or revoked.

variable.description: (Required) The external id of the order to update

response.name: OK

variable.description: (Required) The external id of the order to update
(Required) The external id of the order to update

item.name: Confirm a delivery window for order

request.name: Confirm a delivery window for order

description.content: Confirm a previously booked delivery window for an order. Finalizes the booking and commits the capacity reservation.

variable.description: (Required) The external id of the order to update

response.name: OK

variable.description: (Required) The external id of the order to update
(Required) The external id of the order to update

item.name: Revoke a delivery window for order

request.name: Revoke a delivery window for order

description.content: Revoke a previously booked delivery window for an order. Releases the capacity reservation and disassociates the window from the order.

variable.description: (Required) The external id of the order to update

response.name: OK
